title: Multi-level framework for scientific writing — companion and prompt library
description:
A companion to Andreas Trabesinger's Multi-level framework for scientific writing (Version 1.4), published on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18148137). That document sets out four hierarchical levels of scientific writing — manuscript, section, paragraph/sentence, word — as a single-page visual reference.

This companion expands each level into full checklists for direct use by writers and editors, and converts every checklist item into a ready-to-use prompt for AI-assisted writing and editing. The prompts are written generically and work with any LLM-based assistant.

This release corresponds to Framework v1.4. See the linked repository for the current, editable version.
notes: Companion document to the Multi-level framework for scientific writing (v1.4). Please cite alongside the framework's concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18148137, which always resolves to the latest version.
